_about: Preflop strategy for full-ring (7-10 player) cash games against loose, passive players, with straddles, antes, deep stacks and the 7-2 bounty. These are hand-built approximations of common full-ring ranges with exploitative adjustments, NOT solver output. Edit freely; notation: 77+ (pairs 77 and up), ATs+ (ATs..AKs), TT-66, A5s-A2s, KQo, KQ (both suited and offsuit). All sizes are in big blinds; when someone straddles, every size is multiplied by the straddle (in big blinds), so a 3 BB open becomes 3 straddles.

open._about: First in, picked by how many players (not counting the blinds) act after you, so short tables use later-seat ranges. The straddler counts as a player after you because they act last.
open.MP: 66+ A9s+ KTs+ QTs+ JTs T9s AJo+ KQo
open.LJ: 55+ A7s+ A5s KTs+ QTs+ JTs T9s 98s ATo+ KQo
open.HJ: 44+ A2s+ K9s+ Q9s+ J9s+ T9s 98s 87s ATo+ KJo+
open.CO: 22+ A2s+ K7s+ Q8s+ J8s+ T8s+ 97s+ 87s 76s 65s A8o+ KTo+ QTo+ JTo
open.BU: 22+ A2s+ K2s+ Q5s+ J7s+ T7s+ 96s+ 86s+ 75s+ 65s 54s A2o+ K8o+ Q9o+ J9o+ T9o
open.SB: 22+ A2s+ K5s+ Q8s+ J8s+ T8s+ 98s 87s 76s A7o+ KTo+ QJo

call_raise._about: Calling one raise. in_position: you are not in the blinds. small_blind / big_blind: you are in that blind. When someone straddles, the straddler uses big_blind and the big blind uses small_blind (it has only half a straddle in).
call_raise.in_position: 22+ AJs+ ATs KQs KJs QJs JTs T9s 98s AQo
call_raise.big_blind: 22+ A2s+ KTs+ QTs+ J9s+ T9s 98s 87s 76s AJo+ KQo

call_raise_multiway: 22+ A2s+ KTs+ QTs+ JTs T9s 98s 87s AQo+

vs_late_position_raise._about: Used when a single raise comes from CO, BU or SB: those ranges are wide, so defend and 3-bet wider.
vs_late_position_raise.in_position: 22+ A8s+ A5s A4s KTs+ QTs+ JTs T9s 98s 87s AJo KQo
vs_late_position_raise.big_blind: 22+ A2s+ A7o+ K5s+ K9o+ Q8s+ QTo+ J8s+ JTo T7s+ T9o 97s+ 86s+ 75s+ 65s 54s

facing_three_bet._about: When you face a 3-bet. The 3-bettor's measured 3-bet % picks the column: tight (under tight_below %), loose (loose_at_least % or more), otherwise normal. Players with no 3-bet history (under min_hands hands, unless their stats are already blended toward your games' averages) use normal. Your games average about 9% 3-bets, which is a fairly wide range, so normal calls more than a textbook tight game would. call_after_opening: you raised first and got 3-bet. call_cold: someone raised, someone else 3-bet, and you have not raised; calling cold is riskier (the first raiser can still 4-bet and you are often dominated), so those ranges are tighter. in_position_extra is added to call_after_opening when you act after the 3-bettor on later streets. Deep stacks add more (see deep_stacks).

loose.in_position_extra: 88 77 ATs KJs QJs JTs AJo KQo

facing_four_bet._about: When you face a 4-bet or more. all_in: get all your chips in. call: call and see a flop. Everything else folds. vs_loose_all_in / vs_loose_call are used when the raiser 3-bets a lot (facing_three_bet.loose_at_least) or raises a lot preflop (player_types.loose_raiser_pfr). Home-game 4-bets are almost always very strong. Deep stacks use tighter ranges (see deep_stacks). When the 4-bet already puts a big share of the stack in (sizing.all_in_when_raise_uses_share_of_stack), the call hands get it in too.

deep_stacks._about: Changes when the effective stack (the smaller of your stack and the raiser's; before any raise, the smaller of yours and the biggest other stack) is deep, in big blinds (in straddles when there is a straddle). Your games start with a median of about 240 BB, and a quarter of stacks are 400 BB or more. Each tier applies from its number up to the next tier ('150' covers 150 to 300 BB, '300' covers 300 BB and up); under 150 BB nothing here applies. add_to_calls is added to the ranges for calling a raise or limping behind when you are not in the blinds; add_to_calls_from_blinds is added to the small and big blind calling ranges (neither is added against a nit, whose call_raise.vs_nit range is used as it is). Deep stacks pay off hands that can make sets, straights and flushes. remove_from_calls is taken out of the ranges for calling a raise from early or middle position (or a raise with callers): offsuit hands that make second-best pairs and lose big pots. add_to_three_bet_calls_in_position is added when you opened, got 3-bet, and will act after the 3-bettor. facing_four_bet replaces those ranges: at this depth only AA wants all the money in.

150.add_to_calls_from_blinds: 22+ A5s A4s KJs QJs JTs T9s 98s 87s

300.remove_from_calls: AJo KJo QJo KTo ATo QTo JTo KQo
300.add_to_three_bet_calls_in_position: 99-22 ATs A5s A4s KJs QJs JTs T9s 98s

antes._about: Dead money (small blind + big blind + antes + straddle + any dead blinds) makes the pot bigger before anyone acts, so stealing it is worth more and defending is cheaper. It is counted in big blinds, or in straddles when there is a straddle (raise sizes grow with the straddle too); with no antes it is 1.5. Your games have 0.1 to 0.5 BB antes in about a third of hands: 0.25 BB antes at 9 players make 3.75 BB. At widen_when_dead_money_bb_at_least you open with the next-later seat's range (one step wider: MP uses LJ, the small blind uses BU), at widen_two_steps_when_dead_money_bb_at_least two steps; BU is already the widest. The blinds also defend a little wider (the *_defense_extra ranges are added to their calling ranges, except against a nit). open_extra_bb_per_bb_of_antes adds this much to opens and isolation raises for each big blind of antes in the pot, so callers don't get too good a price.
antes.big_blind_defense_extra: K9s Q9s T8s 97s 86s 75s 65s 64s 54s ATo KJo QJo
antes.small_blind_defense_extra: ATs A9s A5s KJs QJs JTs T9s AJo KQo

bounty._about: 7-2 game: whoever wins a hand holding 7-2 (suited or not) collects the bounty from every other player dealt in, even when everyone folds. Your games pay 3 to 4 BB per player, so with 9 players a 3 BB bounty is worth 24 BB on top of the pot. With 72: first in or over limpers, raise it like a normal open. Facing one raise (with at most max_callers_for_three_bet callers), 3-bet when the bounty is worth at least three_bet_when_bounty_at_least_x_cost times the chips the 3-bet costs; this assumes the raiser folds about a third of the time and 72 still wins sometimes when called. Facing a 3-bet or more, fold.

price_defense._about: When you close the preflop action facing one raise (the big blind, or the heads-up small blind after the big blind raises your limp), call or fold by price instead of a fixed range: call when your equity against the players still in, times the share of it a hand like yours keeps playing out of position (realization), beats the equity the call needs by 'margin'. The price changes with the raise size (a 2x open needs 25%, 3x needs 33%, 4x needs 37.5%), which a fixed range can't see. Realization shares are estimates inside the range published for big blind defense (about 60 to 85 percent; suited and connected hands keep more, offsuit unconnected hands less), not solver output. Very deep stacks cost offsuit hands a little more (they lose big pots to better kickers). 3-bets still come from the charts. Set enabled to false to use the fixed ranges.

heads_up._about: Heads-up (2 players dealt). The small blind is the button: it acts first preflop and last after the flop, so it plays far more hands. Approximations of common heads-up strategy, not solver output.
heads_up.bb_raise_vs_limp: 55+ A7s+ A5s A4s KTs+ QTs+ JTs A9o+ KJo+
heads_up.sb_call_vs_three_bet: 22+ A7s+ A5s A4s ATo+ K9s+ KJo+ QTs+ QJo JTs T9s 98s
